findings.result: Reservation registration holds only registry monitor and releases before any suspending work; repository outer reservation spans blob write, hash, and metadata transaction. Sweep acquires BEGIN IMMEDIATE then registry; active writers skipped without waiting. Shared canonical-directory registry covers same-process old/new store instances.

Revalidates exact NOTE IDs and non-NOTE dependent ID/kind under same writer transaction; deletes attachment/text rows and indexes atomically, preserves saved quote payloads and non-NOTE content while detaching source. Repeated already-gone operation remains idempotent.

Volatile committed acknowledgement runs immediately after successful outer COMMIT before change emission. Blob unlink is post-commit; failure/cancellation leaves pending truth and sweep retry. Source uses existing commit/cancellation mechanism; app must retain receipt inside outer transaction to observe COMMIT if dispatcher return is cancelled.

PDF source existence check and NOTE creation share a transaction. ZIP pre-attachment notes are linked with attachment insertion after exact expected-source revalidation; attachment-first later notes revalidate new attachment and link in note transaction. Earlier imported entries retain existing partial-import semantics on failure.

vec0 write now checks live chunk joined to document within BEGIN IMMEDIATE, skips missing IDs and publishes only accepted ones; existing replaceChunks/replaceEdges parent guards remain. This is not a new claim about cross-session stale IDs.

Only no-follow regular files matching UUID blob or recognized expired temp names can unlink. Live document/source IDs, active IDs, unknown names, directories, symlinks and recent temps remain. Missing blob metadata is preserved; deletion errors counted.

14 instrumentation tests found including real encrypted SQLite/SKAT lifecycle fixtures, failed outer COMMIT, post-commit unlink failure/reopen, late vector negative control, membership/dependent changes, lock cancellation, write/commit reservation, PDF and both ZIP orderings. Four host orphan-sweep cases use real SKAT files. Reviewer executed none; coordinator/implementer own current build and emulator gates.

limits: Read-only source/test design review; no Gradle, native SQLite instrumentation, device, or owner-vault actions.
Root app editor reservation, routing, pre-unlock sweep wiring and owner UI acceptance not included in this backend review.
No new whole-archive atomicity guarantee: earlier archive entries retain existing partial-import behavior.
No claim of multi-process attachment writers; shared registry is process-local and production design must retain one app process owner.
